description: At night the windmills of Consuegra stand in a floodlit row along the crest of Cerro Calderico, their whitewashed towers and sails glowing against the starry sky while the ruined castle of La Muela keeps watch behind them. Below, the dark plains of La Mancha stretch to the horizon — the same emptiness Cervantes gave his knight. Seeing the illuminated hill is, as travellers put it, reason enough to stay a little longer.

prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Photorealistic artistic interpretation of the windmills of Consuegra, Spain, at night, on Cerro Calderico. A row of whitewashed 16th-century windmills with their sails stands along the ridge, floodlit warm against a dark starry night sky; the ruined medieval castle rises behind them on the hill. The dark La Mancha plains stretch below. No identifiable people prominent. Subject centred so it survives a 4:5 centre crop. No text or brand logos anywhere, no on-image text at all.
